description.value: West Coast Suites at UBC are the campus's most premium offering—modern Signature Studio and One-Bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, available year-round on the University of British Columbia's forested Point Grey campus. The property is sustainably heated by biomass generation and hydro electricity, and sits about 20–25 minutes from downtown Vancouver by car or transit. For touring cyclists, the location provides a quiet, scenic base with direct access to Pacific Spirit Regional Park trails and the broader Metro Vancouver cycling network.

address.value: 5961 Student Union Boulevard, Vancouver, BC V6T 2C9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and detailed. The site confirms an operating hotel-suites property on the UBC campus with year-round availability, active booking, and contact details. Amenities listed include laundry facilities and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi across multiple subpages. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
